summary: This FiftyFive Technologies Policy on referral policy is released for use in FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited with effect from 01 January 2026. This document is subject to FiftyFive Technologies Pvt Limited Procedure and subject to change at any time as per the company policy.
key_rules: All current employees of FiftyFive Technologies including trainees on rolls of the Company are covered under this policy.
The referral Policy hence is not applicable for the HR department as it is to be considered that they are a part of hiring procedures.
The referral policy is not applicable for the freelancers/ part timers in the company. Procedure

Employees may refer individuals who fit the specifications given in job descriptions for vacant positions which Human Resources posts from time to time. Note: If the referred candidate’s resume is already available in the Company’s database or has been referred earlier through another source, the referral will be considered on a first- come, first-served basis. Duplicate referrals will not be eligible for referral incentives.
The employee’s role will be limited to the submission of the resume of the candidate. After this the regular process of short listing and interviews will be applied to the referrals also.
The employee making the referral will not in any way be involved with the interview or salary fixation of the candidate.
Selection of referred candidates by any employee would be made only after going through the selection process, as per recruitment policy / procedures.
There should be no specific canvassing in case of a referred candidate by both the employee who referred him and the HR.

If the preferred candidate is hired, the referrer is eligible to claim a referral fee as per the parameters defined below: Parameters The following is the referral incentive applicable under this policy: Experience Referral Incentive in Grade Bracket INR Associate Technical Lead/Senior Manager/Senior Software Developers/Senior 5 Years and above 25,000 Executives/ Manager Software Developers/Software 1 Years-4 Years 15,000 Engineers/Executives Trainee/Intern - NIL The Referral incentive is paid along with the salary after the successful completion of the referred candidate’s 3 months with the Company and hence referral bonus will be credited to the payroll of the falling month. Terms & Conditions:
The incentive will be credited to the employee only if the new recruit completes 3 months of employment with the organization.
Incentive amounts and eligibility factors are subject to change based on the business and economic needs of FiftyFive Technologies.
Incentive will be applicable only on the first come first served.
COMPANY, will not enter into any debate with an employee who has unsuccessfully referred a personal contact. In the event of any dispute, the decision of the Head of Human Resources shall be final.
All recommendations made by the company’s employees must come from their personal contacts / connections and not through any recruitment agency.

Referral bonus is not applicable for the employees working in the human resources department/ the freelancers/part-timers in the company or employees on a contractual basis. Right to Amend Policies This Employee Handbook is intended to provide general guidance on Company policies and practices. FiftyFive Technologies reserves the right to amend, modify, suspend, or withdraw any policy, procedure, or benefit described in this handbook at any time, with or without notice, based on business, operational, or legal requirements.
